# Ticketer

Namespace `Nfty.Ticket` in assembly `Nfty.Ticket`.

```csharp
public static class Ticketer
```

The roll: decides a whole asset and touches no pixels.

## Remarks

**This is the only roll of an asset in the product.** `Generator` calls it and keeps only the render, and `StackRoll.ForRecipe` (the recipe preview) calls it too, so there is exactly one definition of the order in which an asset's layers consume the RNG. Two copies is how "the same seed produces the same collection" stops being true, and the difference would be invisible until a server and a client disagreed about what had been dropped.
